import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const zones = tencentcloud.availability.getZonesByProduct({
    product: "sqlserver",
});
const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    name: "vpc-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    availabilityZone: zones.then(zones => zones.zones?.[4]?.name),
    name: "subnet-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
    isMulticast: false,
});
const securityGroup = new tencentcloud.security.Group("security_group", {
    name: "sg-example",
    description: "desc.",
});
const exampleBasicInstance = new tencentcloud.sqlserver.BasicInstance("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    availabilityZone: zones.then(zones => zones.zones?.[4]?.name),
    chargeType: "POSTPAID_BY_HOUR",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
    projectId: 0,
    memory: 4,
    storage: 100,
    cpu: 2,
    machineType: "CLOUD_PREMIUM",
    maintenanceWeekSets: [
        1,
        2,
        3,
    ],
    maintenanceStartTime: "09:00",
    maintenanceTimeSpan: 3,
    securityGroups: [securityGroup.id],
    tags: {
        test: "test",
    },
});
const exampleDb = new tencentcloud.sqlserver.Db("example", {
    instanceId: exampleBasicInstance.id,
    name: "tf_example_db",
    charset: "Chinese_PRC_BIN",
    remark: "test-remark",
});
const exampleGeneralBackup = new tencentcloud.sqlserver.GeneralBackup("example", {
    instanceId: exampleDb.id,
    backupName: "tf_example_backup",
    strategy: 0,
});
const example = tencentcloud.sqlserver.getBackupByFlowIdOutput({
    instanceId: exampleGeneralBackup.instanceId,
    flowId: exampleGeneralBackup.flowId,
});

			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),

			ChargeType:       pulumi.String("POSTPAID_BY_HOUR"),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:         subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),

			MaintenanceWeekSets: pulumi.IntArray{
				pulumi.Int(1),
				pulumi.Int(2),
				pulumi.Int(3),
			},
			MaintenanceStartTime: pulumi.String("09:00"),

				securityGroup.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			},
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"test": pulumi.String("test"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err

		exampleDb, err := sqlserver.NewDb(ctx, "example", &sqlserver.DbArgs{
			InstanceId: exampleBasicInstance.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Name:       pulumi.String("tf_example_db"),
			Charset:    pulumi.String("Chinese_PRC_BIN"),
			Remark:     pulumi.String("test-remark"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err

		exampleGeneralBackup, err := sqlserver.NewGeneralBackup(ctx, "example", &sqlserver.GeneralBackupArgs{

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;

import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.Group;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.GroupArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Sqlserver.BasicInstance;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Sqlserver.BasicInstanceArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Sqlserver.Db;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Sqlserver.DbArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Sqlserver.GeneralBackup;

import java.io.File;

import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        final var zones = AvailabilityFunctions.getZonesByProduct(GetZonesByProductArgs.builder()
            .product("sqlserver")
            .build());

        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("vpc-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone(zones.zones()[4].name())
            .name("subnet-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .isMulticast(false)
            .build());

        var securityGroup = new Group("securityGroup", GroupArgs.builder()
            .name("sg-example")
            .description("desc.")
            .build());

        var exampleBasicInstance = new BasicInstance("exampleBasicInstance", BasicInstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .availabilityZone(zones.zones()[4].name())
            .chargeType("POSTPAID_BY_HOUR")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .projectId(0)
            .memory(4)
            .storage(100)
            .cpu(2)
            .machineType("CLOUD_PREMIUM")
            .maintenanceWeekSets(            
                1,
                2,
                3)
            .maintenanceStartTime("09:00")
            .maintenanceTimeSpan(3)
            .securityGroups(securityGroup.id())
            .tags(Map.of("test", "test"))
            .build());

        var exampleDb = new Db("exampleDb", DbArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(exampleBasicInstance.id())
            .name("tf_example_db")
            .charset("Chinese_PRC_BIN")
            .remark("test-remark")
            .build());

        var exampleGeneralBackup = new GeneralBackup("exampleGeneralBackup", GeneralBackupArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(exampleDb.id())
            .backupName("tf_example_backup")
            .strategy(0)
            .build());

        final var example = SqlserverFunctions.getBackupByFlowId(GetBackupByFlowIdArgs.builder()
            .instanceId(exampleGeneralBackup.instanceId())
            .flowId(exampleGeneralBackup.flowId())
            .build());

    }
}
